name: Marina Grill
short: A local favorite at the marina, serving local catch such as mahi as ceviche, grilled or in tacos, with a view over the boats.
orders: Skip the tortilla or fries; ask for sauces on the side
hoursNote: Hours not confirmed from a primary source. Call or check the day of.

name: Crab Daddy Agana
short: A Louisiana-style seafood boil house on Marine Corps Drive: crab, lobster, crawfish, mussels, shrimp and squid, plus grilled entrées. About 10 minutes from Oceanview Drive.
orders: For a lighter, less sauced meal, choose a grilled entrée over the full boil
If you go for the boil, order the seasoning on the side and skip the corn and potatoes
hoursNote: Noon to 10 p.m. at its 2019 opening. Confirm current hours.

name: Fisherman's Cove
q: Fisherman's Cove, Hilton Guam Resort, Tumon
short: Pick your fish, lobster, crab or shrimp from a market display and the kitchen prepares it the way you ask, with your choice of seasonings.
orders: Choose a whole local fish or fillet from the display, grilled or steamed
Ask for sauces and butter on the side
Book ahead; diners report waits without a reservation
hoursNote: Dinner reported 6 to 9:30 p.m. (older listing). Reserve on OpenTable and confirm.

name: Beachin' Shrimp
q: Beachin' Shrimp, 1225 Pale San Vitores Rd, Tumon, Guam
short: Shrimp-centric coastal cooking drawing on California, Mexico and Louisiana, in the center of Tumon.
orders: Ask about salad or vegetable sides in place of rice or pasta
hoursNote: Reported daily 10 a.m. to 9 p.m. Confirm current hours.
